item.title: Design a Real-time Gaming Leaderboard
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: Ranking 25 million players in real time. Why SQL cannot do it, how a skip list makes it O(log n), and the sharding problem that has no clean answer — with a live leaderboard you can play with.
